_comment: Yard Site — English (US) strings. Keep these short: the site map runs at small GUI scales.
yardsite.screen.title: Biome Site Map
yardsite.screen.title.detail: Biome Site Map · Chunk detail (1 cell = 1 chunk)
yardsite.screen.hint.sandbox: LMB drag = orbit · RMB drag = pan · MMB drag = flip · Scroll = zoom · LMB click = select · Double-click = chunk detail · R = reset
yardsite.screen.hint.detail: LMB drag = orbit · RMB drag = move window (new edge is sampled as it appears) · MMB drag = flip · Scroll = zoom · LMB click = select (snaps to chunk) · R = reset
yardsite.screen.hint.edit.pick: Edit mode: click a cell to recolor its biome (site unchanged) · ESC = put the eyedropper down
yardsite.screen.hint.edit.normal: Edit mode: Alt+click a cell to pick its color · ESC = exit
yardsite.screen.notice.failedHint: Click Back to change the settings, or return to the vanilla screen
yardsite.screen.select.none.detail: Click a cell to put the %s on that chunk; Back to sandbox to move elsewhere
yardsite.screen.select.none.sandbox: Click = put the %s on that cell · Double-click = chunk detail · Chunk detail = use the marker, or the default spawn if there is none
yardsite.screen.select.sampling: Site x=%s z=%s · this cell is still sampling…
yardsite.screen.select.water.plot: (water — the build fills in below the floor)
yardsite.screen.select.exact: · the build is pinned to this chunk
yardsite.screen.bottom.failed: Sampling failed. Click Back to change the settings, or return to the vanilla screen
yardsite.screen.bottom.sampling.detail: New chunks are still being sampled — you can move the window now
yardsite.screen.bottom.sampling.sandbox: Terrain is growing outward from the center — you can orbit and select already
yardsite.reveal.info.generating: The server is generating spawn chunks…
